title: Kashmiri Pulao
subtitle: Saffron pilaf · Instant Pot · 3 adult servings + toddler
protein: ~9g protein per adult serving — pair with raita, dal or a paneer sabji

method.title: Prep & soak
items: Rinse rice {1½ cups} in several changes of water until mostly clear
Soak in fresh water for 30 min, then drain completely
Warm milk {4½ tbsp} for 20–30 sec; stir in saffron {3 pinches} and set aside
Coarsely crush fennel seeds {¾ tsp}
Dice apple and pineapple {¾ cup total}; refrigerate until serving

method.title: Fry nuts, then spices
items: Set Instant Pot to Sauté; heat ghee {1½ tbsp}
Fry cashews {12–15} until light golden, about 1 min
Add raisins {1½ tbsp}; fry 15–20 sec until plump
Remove cashews {12–15} and raisins {1½ tbsp} to a plate and set aside for garnish
Add ghee {1 tbsp}, then bay leaf {1}, green cardamom {4}, cloves {6}, cinnamon {1 inch}, black cardamom {1} and caraway {¾ tsp}
Stir 20–30 sec until fragrant; don't let them darken
Add crushed fennel {¾ tsp}, dry ginger powder {¾ tsp} and hing {⅛ tsp}; stir 10 sec

method.title: Roast rice & pressure cook
items: Add drained rice {1½ cups}, salt {½ tsp}, sugar {1½ tbsp} and ghee {1 tbsp}
Fry gently 2–3 min until grains look dry and smell nutty
Pour in saffron milk {4½ tbsp} and water {1¾ cups}; scrape the bottom clean
Taste the water — it should be lightly salty
Lock the lid, seal the valve, Pressure Cook on High {5 min}
Natural release {5–6 min}, then vent
Open and fluff gently with a fork

method.label: Toddler — scoop after fluffing, before garnish
items: Scoop about {½ cup} pulao into a small bowl before any garnish goes on
Pick out every whole spice: bay leaf, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon
Optional: stir in soft boiled carrot or potato, finely diced {1–2 tbsp}
Top with cashews crushed to coarse crumbs {1 tsp} and chopped raisins {1 tsp}
Add finely diced apple and pineapple {2 tbsp}
Let it cool to warm before serving

method.title: Garnish & serve
items: Transfer the adult pulao to a serving bowl
Top with the set-aside cashews and raisins {rest}
Scatter pomegranate arils {⅓ cup} and diced apple and pineapple {rest of the ¾ cup}
Serve warm
Store leftover rice plain in the fridge; add fruit fresh to each serving
Reheat with a splash of water in the microwave

method.label: Tip
method.text: Water ratio assumes aged basmati in the Instant Pot; on the stovetop use 3 cups and cook covered on the lowest heat. Best with a pomegranate raita.
